name: Need to Integrate New Portfolio Analysis Report on the Research 360 External Holding
what: Integrate the new Portfolio Analysis Report within Research 360 to include external holdings and provide a consolidated view of the client's overall investment portfolio.
why: This will enable comprehensive portfolio analysis across internal and external holdings, helping advisors identify portfolio transfer opportunities, improve client engagement, support new client acquisition, and potentially increase trading and investment activity within Motilal Oswal platforms.
impactArea: Portfolio Analysis Report API used from data lake

name: Revamp of Payment Summary Page in Front End
what: Redesign and modernize the Payment Summary page with an improved user interface, enhanced usability, and alignment with current design standards.
why: The existing payment page does not align with current UI/UX standards. A revamped interface will improve user experience, reduce client confusion, and provide a more intuitive and consistent payment journey.

name: AI-Based Personalized Portfolio Creation
what: Implement an AI-driven portfolio recommendation engine that generates personalized portfolios based on client risk profile, investment objectives, investment behavior, and market conditions.
why: Personalized recommendations can improve investment outcomes, increase client engagement, enhance customer satisfaction, and differentiate the platform from competitors by offering tailored investment solutions.

name: AI Assistant for Client Journey Platform
what: Develop and integrate an AI-powered virtual assistant capable of addressing client queries related to portfolio performance, order status, product information, onboarding, and platform usage.
why: The AI assistant will improve customer experience by providing instant support, reducing dependency on customer service teams, increasing self-service adoption, and lowering operational support costs.

name: Database and Application Performance Optimization
what: Optimize the existing database architecture, queries, indexing strategy, and data processing mechanisms to improve overall application performance and scalability.
why: As transaction volumes and user traffic increase, performance optimization is essential to ensure system stability, faster response times, improved scalability, and reduced infrastructure costs.

name: IMP Front End Screen – New UI Implementation
what: Redesign and implement a modern, responsive, and user-friendly interface across IMP front-end screens with improved navigation and usability.
why: A modern user interface will improve customer engagement, simplify navigation, enhance accessibility, and align the platform with current digital experience standards.

name: BOT for New Clients in IAP
what: Implement an intelligent onboarding bot to guide new clients through account setup, product selection, portfolio creation, and investment initiation.
why: The onboarding bot will simplify the client onboarding process, improve conversion rates, reduce onboarding drop-offs, and decrease manual support efforts.

name: Money Payout Flow Simplification
what: Simplify the client withdrawal and payout journey by reducing manual steps, automating validations, and integrating with payout processing APIs.
why: A streamlined payout process will improve customer satisfaction, reduce operational effort, minimize processing errors, and accelerate withdrawal turnaround times.

name: Report Revamp
what: Redesign client-facing and internal reports with enhanced visualizations, improved data presentation, interactive dashboards, and downloadable PDF/Excel formats.
why: Improved reporting capabilities will provide better insights, support informed decision-making, enhance user experience, and reduce dependency on support teams for data interpretation.

name: One-Click Order Execution of Rebalance Recommendation
what: Enable clients to execute portfolio rebalance recommendations directly through a single-click order placement mechanism.
why: Simplifying execution will increase adoption of rebalance recommendations, improve client convenience, reduce execution delays, and drive higher transaction volumes in IMP

name: Multiple Portfolio Options for Portfolio Rebalance
what: Enhance the portfolio rebalance process by providing multiple recommended portfolio options for client selection before executing the rebalance.
why: Offering portfolio choices increases personalization, improves client satisfaction, enhances decision-making flexibility, and improves conversion rates for rebalance recommendations.

name: New Product Addition Module through Admin Utility
what: Develop an administrative utility that enables business users to create, configure, and manage new investment products without technical intervention.
why: This will reduce dependency on development teams, accelerate product launches, improve operational efficiency, and provide greater flexibility for business users.

name: Integration of Holdings & Cash from CBOS Across Systems
what: Establish a centralized integration framework to consume client holdings and cash balances from CBOS and synchronize processing across CBOS, IAP, and Restock platforms.
why: Maintaining the same data across multiple systems leads to operational inefficiencies and reconciliation challenges. Centralized integration will improve data consistency, reduce maintenance efforts, and establish a single source of truth.

name: Production Support Utility for Operational Issue Resolution
what: Develop a centralized utility platform to address common production issues, operational requests, data corrections, and support activities through self-service tools.
why: The utility will reduce dependency on technical teams, enable faster issue resolution, improve operational efficiency, minimize business disruptions, and enhance overall support productivity.

name: Consolidation of IAP Back Office with Restock Platform
what: Eliminate the existing IAP Front Office/Back Office processing layer and migrate all portfolio management, order processing, holdings management, cash management, and operational workflows to the Restock platform. The IAP application will continue to serve as the client-facing front end while Restock will function as the unified backend and operational engine for both IAP and IMP products.
why: Maintaining separate backend systems for IAP and Restock results in duplicate development efforts, higher maintenance costs, operational complexity, and data synchronization challenges. Consolidating the backend into a single platform will establish a unified operating model, improve scalability, reduce technology and support costs, accelerate feature delivery, ensure data consistency, simplify integrations, and provide a centralized source of truth across all advisory and portfolio management products.

name: Auto Mailer for all Withdrawal Requests Raised (IAP / IMP)
what: Automatically trigger email notifications to mapped RM, RM TL, Regional Heads, and relevant stakeholders whenever a client places a partial or full withdrawal request.
why: Improves visibility of withdrawal activities, enables proactive client engagement and retention efforts, and helps business teams intervene in case of large redemption requests.

name: Auto Transfer Activity on T+n with Auto Email from RIA
what: Automate portfolio transfer processing and trigger client communication emails from RIA upon successful completion of transfer activities on the defined settlement date (T+n).
why: Reduces manual intervention, improves operational efficiency, enhances client communication, and ensures timely updates regarding transfer status.

name: Email Utility
what: Create a centralized utility allowing authorized users to send customized emails directly to clients from the application.
why: Eliminates dependency on external tools, improves communication efficiency, and provides an audit trail for all client communications.

name: ReStock Performance NAV Calculation for Cash Allocation Products
what: Enhance NAV calculation methodology to consider uninvested cash balances along with invested holdings for products where full deployment is not mandatory.
why: Provides accurate performance measurement and reflects the true portfolio value for products following tactical cash allocation strategies.
impactArea: Current Logic Revamp of NAV Calcualtion

name: ReStock Performance NAV Calculation to Include Corporate Actions
what: Incorporate dividends, bonus issues, stock splits, rights issues, and other corporate actions into daily NAV and performance calculations.
why: Ensures accurate performance reporting, improves transparency, and aligns portfolio returns with actual investor gains.
impactArea: Current Logic Revamp of NAV Calcualtion

name: ReStock Portfolio Upload via Excel
what: Enable portfolio creation, modification, and rebalancing through structured Excel uploads instead of manual data entry.
why: Reduces manual effort, minimizes data entry errors, improves operational efficiency, and accelerates portfolio management activities.

name: Daily IMP Business MIS
what: Generate and distribute a daily automated MIS containing IMP business metrics, net inflows/outflows, AUM movement, and brokerage revenue details.
why: Provides management with timely business insights, supports decision-making, and helps monitor business performance on a daily basis.

name: Corporate Action Alert
what: Send automated notifications to clients, advisors, and internal teams regarding upcoming and completed corporate actions impacting portfolio holdings.
why: Enhances client engagement, improves transparency, and ensures all stakeholders remain informed about portfolio-impacting events.

name: Access to Closed Portfolios
what: Provide access to historical details, holdings, transactions, and reports of closed portfolios through advisor and client interfaces.
why: Helps advisors support transfer cases, resolve client queries, and maintain historical visibility for audit and compliance purposes.

name: Brokerage Data in Trade Log
what: Include actual brokerage charged for each transaction within the IAP/IMP trade log and reporting modules.
why: Improves transparency, supports brokerage reconciliation, and provides complete transaction-level information to business and support teams.

name: IMP Front End Changes
what: Redesign and modernize the IMP website and mobile application with enhanced user experience, navigation, and responsive design.
why: Improves client engagement, enhances usability, aligns with modern design standards, and strengthens digital customer experience.

name: Daily IMP Performance Snapshot
what: Generate and distribute a daily performance snapshot covering returns, benchmark comparison, AUM, and key performance metrics for all IMP products.
why: Enables business teams to track product performance, identify trends, and make timely strategic decisions.

name: Pay with Stocks
what: Allow clients to invest in IMP products by contributing existing stock holdings instead of investing entirely through fresh cash.
why: Improves client convenience, facilitates portfolio migration, increases investment conversions, and reduces the need for stock liquidation.
impactArea: Change in the process of investment

name: ReStock Portfolio Rebalancing Maker Checker
what: Implement a maker-checker approval workflow for all portfolio rebalance activities performed through ReStock.
why: Strengthens operational controls, minimizes unauthorized changes, reduces operational risks, and ensures compliance with governance requirements.

name: MTF Report Creation – MTF_Portfolio_PNL
what: Develop a dedicated MTF Portfolio P&L report providing performance, holdings, margin utilization, and profit/loss details for Margin Trading Facility investments.
why: Provides clients and internal teams with better visibility into MTF investments, supports monitoring of leveraged positions, and improves reporting capabilities.
